frequency_question: How often do states with high will and direct assistance successfully stand up domestic assembly of advanced foreign missiles within two years?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign governments under active invasion establishing domestic production lines for advanced foreign cruise or ballistic missiles. Excludes standard small arms, ammunition, and low-tech unguided systems.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic production of Stugna-P/Neptune variants
Taiwan Hsiung Feng III scaling under PRC threat
Iran domestic reverse-engineering and assembly of various precision guided munitions

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; small population due to narrow specificity of advanced missile transfer under war.
known_gaps: Historical scarcity of advanced cruise missile tech transfers directly into active warzones for localized manufacturing.
skeleton: Identified sovereign emergency tech-transfer and manufacturing scaling efforts
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 relevant historical analogies
validity_reason: Technological complexity and geopolitical urgency factors remain stable through the decade.
